# hyperlite_group (Data Source)

A group of accounts, to give it rights (`hyperlite_acl`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hyperlite_group" "ops" {
  name = "ops"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The group's name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Its id.
- `members` (Set of String) Its accounts, by name.
